title: Broken Navigation Menus
description: Fix missing menus, wrong items showing, mobile menu failures, and menus breaking after theme switch or migration.

steps.title: Identify Menu Failure Type
steps.instructions: Note if menu is completely missing, shows wrong items, dropdowns broken, mobile toggle not working, or only on certain pages.

steps.title: Re-assign Menu to Theme Location
steps.instructions: Go to Appearance → Menus and assign the menu to the correct theme location (Primary, Footer, etc.). Theme switches reset location assignments.

steps.title: Verify Menu Items and Links
steps.instructions: Check for broken custom links, trashed pages still in menu, or draft pages assigned. Remove orphaned items and update URLs after migration.

steps.title: Check Theme Builder Override (Elementor/Divi)
steps.instructions: Page builders may replace theme menus with builder headers. Verify header template display conditions and menu widget configuration.

steps.title: Debug Mobile Menu JavaScript
steps.instructions: Mobile toggle often fails from jQuery conflicts or deferred scripts. Check console errors and exclude menu scripts from delay-JS optimization.

steps.title: Purge Cache After Menu Changes
steps.instructions: Full-page cache may serve HTML with old menu. Purge all caches after menu updates. Some caches need manual purge per menu change.

steps.title: Fix Mega Menu Plugin Issues
steps.instructions: Max Mega Menu and similar plugins need reconfiguration after theme change. Re-enable plugin, reassign theme location, and regenerate CSS.

steps.title: Verify Desktop and Mobile Navigation
steps.instructions: Test all menu levels, dropdowns, and mobile hamburger on real devices. Check logged-in vs logged-out if menu differs by role.
